policies.title: Warranty
policies.body:
Laptops carry a 2-year warranty from delivery; components, 3 years; peripherals and accessories, 1 year.

It covers manufacturing defects and hardware failures under normal use, with repair or replacement. It does not cover misuse, drops, liquids, unauthorized modifications, consumables or third-party software.

To claim, contact the human support team with the order number and the fault: they confirm coverage before authorizing anything.

policies.title: Shipping
policies.body:
Standard: 3 to 5 business days after payment confirmation. Express: 1 to 2 business days for selected destinations.

Standard is free on orders over 50 USD; below that it costs 4.90 USD. Express costs 9.90 USD where available.

Every shipment includes tracking. If it does not arrive in time, contact the human support team with the order number.

policies.title: Returns
policies.body:
You have 30 calendar days from delivery to return without giving a reason, with the product unused, accessories and original packaging.

The refund reaches the original payment method within 5 to 10 business days after inspection. The assistant can never promise refunds.

Any exception (extended windows, used products) needs human approval: the assistant hands those cases to a person.

policies.title: Payment methods
policies.body:
Credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) via Stripe Checkout. The store never receives or stores card data.

If the payment fails or expires, the stock reservation is released and the order is cancelled; you may try again. For apparent duplicate charges, only the human team can verify the charge in Stripe.

policies.title: Privacy
policies.body:
We process email, name, shipping address and order history for the purchase.

The assistant never receives your email, address, identity document or payment data: only your question, the catalog and the retrieved fragments.

You may request access, rectification or deletion of your data from the human support team.
